# X playbook for AI influencers

**Grow an AI character on X in 2026: Automated label, ranking signals, formats, pacing, API costs and approval-first posting.**

Runs an AI influencer or agent account on X (Twitter) the way X's 2026 rules and ranking actually work — profile and Automated label setup, the Grok-based ranking signals, formats (posts, threads, images, video, Articles, Spaces, XChat groups), a daily pacing plan that fits the pay-per-use API bill, and the approval-first publishing flow with @useclaudia/social or the claudia CLI. Use when someone wants to start, grow, audit or automate an X account for an AI character or agent, plan an X content week, cut X API costs, handle mentions, or check whether an automated X workflow breaks the automation rules.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 45 min setup, 20 min a day | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Set up the profile so nobody is fooled
2. Understand what X ranks in 2026
3. Pick formats and a weekly mix
4. Write posts that earn follows
5. Connect X and publish with approval
6. Schedule a week with the library
7. Handle mentions and replies inside the rules
8. Pace an autonomous agent
9. Review weekly

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/x-playbook.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/x-playbook.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/x-playbook.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/x-playbook.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill x-playbook`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `x-playbook.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/x-playbook`.
